page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m2.medium is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m2 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not feature integrated graphics processing units and is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.m2.medium offers a high memory allocation relative to its compute capacity, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring significant RAM without demanding massive parallel processing power. Suitable workloads include in-memory caching, medium-sized databases, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
